systems_blueprint_generations_service_en.value: typeof(service_engagement_id) = 'text' AND length(service_engagement_id) > 0 AND instr(service_engagement_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_service_ty.name: systems_blueprint_generations_service_type_id_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_service_ty.value: typeof(service_type_id) = 'text' AND length(service_type_id) > 0 AND instr(service_type_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_binding_id.name: systems_blueprint_generations_binding_id_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_binding_id.value: typeof(binding_id) = 'text' AND length(binding_id) > 0 AND instr(binding_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_template_i.name: systems_blueprint_generations_template_id_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_template_i.value: typeof(template_id) = 'text' AND length(template_id) > 0 AND instr(template_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_template_v.name: systems_blueprint_generations_template_version_id_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_template_v.value: typeof(template_version_id) = 'text' AND length(template_version_id) > 0 AND instr(template_version_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_created_by.name: systems_blueprint_generations_created_by_membership_id_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_created_by.value: typeof(created_by_membership_id) = 'text' AND length(created_by_membership_id) > 0 AND instr(created_by_membership_id, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_created_at.name: systems_blueprint_generations_created_at_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_created_at.value: typeof(created_at) = 'text' AND length(created_at) > 0 AND instr(created_at, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_blueprint_.name: systems_blueprint_generations_blueprint_key_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_blueprint_.value: typeof(blueprint_key) = 'text' AND length(blueprint_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND blueprint_key NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*' AND instr(blueprint_key, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_request_ch.name: systems_blueprint_generations_request_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_request_ch.value:
typeof(request_id) = 'text' AND length(request_id) = 36 AND instr(request_id, char(0)) = 0
    AND substr(request_id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(request_id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(request_id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(request_id,24,1) = '-'
    AND substr(request_id,15,1) = '4' AND substr(request_id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')
    AND length(replace(request_id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(request_id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

systems_blueprint_generations_definition.name: systems_blueprint_generations_definition_hash_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_definition.value: typeof(definition_hash) = 'text' AND length(definition_hash) = 64 AND definition_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND instr(definition_hash, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_plan_hash_.name: systems_blueprint_generations_plan_hash_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_plan_hash_.value: typeof(plan_hash) = 'text' AND length(plan_hash) = 64 AND plan_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND instr(plan_hash, char(0)) = 0

systems_blueprint_generations_definition.name: systems_blueprint_generations_definition_json_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_definition.value: CASE WHEN typeof(definition_json) = 'text' AND length(CAST(definition_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 2 AND 32768 AND json_valid(definition_json) THEN json_type(definition_json) = 'object' ELSE 0 END

systems_blueprint_generations_plan_json_.name: systems_blueprint_generations_plan_json_chk
systems_blueprint_generations_plan_json_.value: CASE WHEN typeof(plan_json) = 'text' AND length(CAST(plan_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 2 AND 32768 AND json_valid(plan_json) THEN json_type(plan_json) = 'object' ELSE 0 END

work_setup_generation_counts_ck.name: work_setup_generation_counts_ck
work_setup_generation_counts_ck.value: typeof(milestone_count)='integer' AND milestone_count BETWEEN 0 AND 20 AND typeof(action_count)='integer' AND action_count BETWEEN 0 AND 60 AND typeof(deliverable_count)='integer' AND deliverable_count BETWEEN 0 AND 20 AND typeof(dependency_count)='integer' AND dependency_count BETWEEN 0 AND 180

work_setup_generation_date_ck.name: work_setup_generation_date_ck
work_setup_generation_date_ck.value: length(event_date)=10 AND date(event_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(event_date,'+0 days')=event_date

work_setup_save_operation_ck.name: work_setup_save_operation_ck
work_setup_save_operation_ck.value: operation IN ('save','retire','restore') AND typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1 AND length(intent_hash)=64

bloomops_page_contexts_parent_ck.name: bloomops_page_contexts_parent_ck
bloomops_page_contexts_parent_ck.value: "bloomops_page_contexts"."project_id" IS NULL OR "bloomops_page_contexts"."client_id" IS NOT NULL

bloomops_page_grants_recipient_ck.name: bloomops_page_grants_recipient_ck
bloomops_page_grants_recipient_ck.value: ("bloomops_page_grants"."recipient_role" IN ('project_manager','team_member') AND "bloomops_page_grants"."contact_id" IS NULL) OR ("bloomops_page_grants"."recipient_role"='client' AND "bloomops_page_grants"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL)
